post.title: Experiments Index
post.hook: 29 side projects, one JSON file, and a fluid lab next to a galaxy of Claude sessions
post.summary: A manifest of 29 experiments across two owners, each with a one-line description, stack and last-updated date. It works as the registry behind the feed of side projects.
post.writeup:
## What it is
A single JSON manifest listing 29 experiments. It has two owners (quirq-ai and sharmasuraj0123), an empty skip list, and one entry per experiment with a description, a stack, and usually an updated date. Some entries also carry a source URL, and one (Makepad) is flagged as a pointer rather than a full copy.

## Why it exists
It gives a one-file index of everything built or studied on the side, so each project can be found, described and republished without opening its folder. The empty skip list means nothing is currently excluded.

## What is in it
The range is wide. Some entries are interactive builds: Fractal Lab (a canvas playground), Flow Lab (a Navier-Stokes fluid lab with four experiments), Galaxy Sandbox (every Claude Code session becomes a galaxy), and Hello Sim (a one-screen SwiftUI app for the iOS Simulator). Others are studies: an Autospawn clone with mock data to learn its UX, Makepad examined for its file explorer and treemap, and Marble's os-taxonomy, an open taxonomy of what children learn with 1,590 micro-topics in a prerequisite graph.

Stacks are mostly Next.js and Vite with React, with Swift, Rust, Node.js, Shell and Markdown also present.

## Findings
The visible updated dates run from 2026-05-28 (Artifact Evolution) to 2026-10-09 (Claude Messages), so the set was touched steadily over about five months. Activity clusters in July and September 2026.

## Open questions
The manifest only records descriptions, not outcomes. It does not say which experiments graduated into products, and a couple of entries (Meet Transcripts) have no updated date at all.
